findings.description: render_finish applies the leftover _completed_intervals via make_step and render_progress before the hidden/not-atty check, so it runs even when the bar is hidden or output is not a TTY, and also in cases where finishing should not alter the position.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a bar exits (e.g. via exception or early break) with pending sub-threshold steps. render_finish then adds them to pos, possibly setting finished=True and altering state, even though the bar did not complete. For non-TTY output, render_progress is also invoked an extra time. Impact: pos, finished and ETA state change after the loop, and the apply step is skipped from the hidden/non-TTY guard.
